settings._title: Site header: yellow bar (old homepage design)

settings.html:
<style id="yg-header-css">
/* Shared site header (ElementsKit template 61435), on every page with a menu.
   Design: the old homepage header - yellow bar, white logo, red map icon -
   with the full `mobile-menud` menu. Type matches the previous header. */
.elementor-61435{
  --yg-ink:#16181a; --yg-gold:#fccc04; --yg-gold-deep:#8a6d00; --yg-gold-tint:#fff8dc;
  --yg-stack:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Oxygen-Sans",Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
}

/* ---------- top-level menu: one line ---------- */
.elementor-61435 .yg-hdr-nav{flex-grow:1}
.elementor-61435 .elementskit-navbar-nav{flex-wrap:nowrap}
.elementor-61435 .elementskit-navbar-nav > li > a{
  font-family:var(--yg-stack)!important;font-size:16px!important;font-weight:700!important;
  text-transform:uppercase!important;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1.3!important;white-space:nowrap}

/* ---------- dropdowns ---------- */
.elementor-61435 .elementskit-submenu-panel{
  border:0!important;border-top:3px solid var(--yg-gold)!important;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px!important;
  box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(22,24,26,.14)!important;padding:8px 0!important}
/* no overflow:hidden - it clips the third level (LANGUAGE > German Language > A1..B2) */
.elementor-61435 .elementskit-submenu-panel .elementskit-submenu-panel{
  border-top-width:3px!important;border-radius:8px!important}
.elementor-61435 .elementskit-submenu-panel > li > a{
  font-family:var(--yg-stack)!important;font-size:16px!important;font-weight:600!important;
  text-transform:uppercase!important;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1.35!important;white-space:nowrap;
  color:var(--yg-ink)!important;padding:11px 18px!important;
  border-left:3px solid transparent;transition:background .15s ease,border-color .15s ease}
.elementor-61435 .elementskit-submenu-panel > li > a:hover,
.elementor-61435 .elementskit-submenu-panel > li:hover > a{
  background:var(--yg-gold-tint)!important;border-left-color:var(--yg-gold)}
.elementor-61435 .elementskit-submenu-panel > li.current-menu-item > a{
  background:var(--yg-gold-tint)!important;border-left-color:var(--yg-gold);font-weight:700!important}

/* ---------- red map icon: homepage only (it scrolls to the branches map there) ---------- */
.elementor-61435 .yg-hdr-map{display:none!important}
@media(min-width:1025px){ body.home .elementor-61435 .yg-hdr-map{display:flex!important} }

/* ---------- laptops: eight items still fit on one line ---------- */
@media(min-width:1025px) and (max-width:1440px){
  .elementor-61435 .elementskit-navbar-nav > li > a{font-size:15px!important;padding-left:9px!important;padding-right:9px!important}
}
@media(min-width:1025px) and (max-width:1300px){
  .elementor-61435 .elementskit-navbar-nav > li > a{font-size:14px!important;padding-left:7px!important;padding-right:7px!important}
}

/* ---------- tablet/mobile slide-out panel ---------- */
@media(max-width:1024px){
  .elementor-61435 .elementskit-menu-offcanvas-elements .elementskit-navbar-nav > li > a{
    font-size:16px!important;font-weight:700!important;padding:13px 16px!important;white-space:normal}
  .elementor-61435 .elementskit-menu-offcanvas-elements .elementskit-submenu-panel > li > a{font-size:16px!important;white-space:normal}
}

/* ---------- no white strip under the header ----------
   Some pages start with a block that holds only SEO schema (JSON-LD): nothing to
   show, but Elementor still pads it 10px top and bottom - a white strip under
   the yellow bar. Hide it; the script stays in the page, so Google still reads it. */
.e-con:has(> .elementor-widget-html:only-child > .elementor-widget-container > script[type="application/ld+json"]:only-child),
.e-con:has(> .e-con-inner > .elementor-widget-html:only-child > .elementor-widget-container > script[type="application/ld+json"]:only-child){display:none!important}
/* The page's first section: drop only Elementor's DEFAULT top padding (10px).
   Padding a page sets on purpose is untouched. */
.ekit-template-content-header ~ .content-area .elementor[data-elementor-type^="wp-"] > .e-con:first-child,
.ekit-template-content-header ~ .content-area .elementor[data-elementor-type^="wp-"] > .e-con:first-child:has(> .e-con-inner > .elementor-widget-html:only-child > .elementor-widget-container > script[type="application/ld+json"]:only-child) + .e-con{
  --container-default-padding-top:0px}
/* Older "section > column" pages: the column's default gap padding (10px). Same
   weight as Elementor's default rule and printed after it, so it wins over the
   default only; padding set on a column on purpose still wins. */
:where(.ekit-template-content-header ~ .content-area .elementor[data-elementor-type^="wp-"] > .elementor-section:first-child) .elementor-column-gap-default > .elementor-column > .elementor-element-populated{padding-top:0}
/* If the page's first section has nothing to show at this screen size (e.g. a
   mobile-only banner on desktop), it still leaves its padding: hide it, and the
   section after it loses its default top padding instead. */
@media(min-width:1025px){
  :where(.ekit-template-content-header ~ .content-area .elementor[data-elementor-type^="wp-"]) > .elementor-section:first-child:not(:has(.elementor-widget:not(.elementor-hidden-desktop))){display:none!important}
  :where(:where(.ekit-template-content-header ~ .content-area .elementor[data-elementor-type^="wp-"]) > .elementor-section:first-child:not(:has(.elementor-widget:not(.elementor-hidden-desktop))) + .elementor-section) .elementor-column-gap-default > .elementor-column > .elementor-element-populated{padding-top:0}
}
@media(min-width:768px) and (max-width:1024px){
  :where(.ekit-template-content-header ~ .content-area .elementor[data-elementor-type^="wp-"]) > .elementor-section:first-child:not(:has(.elementor-widget:not(.elementor-hidden-tablet))){display:none!important}
  :where(:where(.ekit-template-content-header ~ .content-area .elementor[data-elementor-type^="wp-"]) > .elementor-section:first-child:not(:has(.elementor-widget:not(.elementor-hidden-tablet))) + .elementor-section) .elementor-column-gap-default > .elementor-column > .elementor-element-populated{padding-top:0}
}
@media(max-width:767px){
  :where(.ekit-template-content-header ~ .content-area .elementor[data-elementor-type^="wp-"]) > .elementor-section:first-child:not(:has(.elementor-widget:not(.elementor-hidden-mobile))){display:none!important}
  :where(:where(.ekit-template-content-header ~ .content-area .elementor[data-elementor-type^="wp-"]) > .elementor-section:first-child:not(:has(.elementor-widget:not(.elementor-hidden-mobile))) + .elementor-section) .elementor-column-gap-default > .elementor-column > .elementor-element-populated{padding-top:0}
}

.elementor-61435 a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--yg-ink);outline-offset:2px}
</style>
